description: Does the MODERATE brevity instruction still let the model extract every required field?

messages.content: Extract the customer name, email, and order ID from this message: Hi, this is Jane Smith, my email is jane@example.com and my order ID is A12345.

tools.name: extract_order_info
tools.description: Extract a customer's name, email, and order ID from a support message

judge_rubric: Rate 1-5 how complete and accurate the extracted order information is. A 5 means every field (name, email, order ID) is present and correct with no extraneous commentary; a 1 means fields are missing, wrong, or buried in unnecessary preamble.

description: A higher-field-count extraction from noisier text -- does MODERATE brevity risk dropping a field under more complex extraction pressure than the simpler 3-field case?

messages.content: Extract all the details from this booking request: "Hi there, I'd like to book a table for 6 people this Friday at 8pm under the name Alvarez. We'll also need a high chair for one toddler, and please note one guest has a shellfish allergy."

tools.name: extract_reservation_details
tools.description: Extract full reservation details including party size, date, time, name, special requests, and allergies

judge_rubric: Rate 1-5 how completely the response captures ALL six details (party size, day, time, name, high chair request, shellfish allergy) under brevity pressure. A 5 captures every detail concisely; a 1 drops one or more details, especially the safety-relevant allergy note.
